'''2020 TMW Pods Chris Gogolen DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Gogolen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Legal Gogolen DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
